questions.q: What is Dave Ramsey's first financial step?
questions.why: He says the first step is to set aside $1,000 for emergencies.

questions.q: What percentage of people face a major bad event in ten years?
questions.why: Money Magazine reports 78% experience a major event in a decade.

questions.q: How does the debt snowball method begin?
questions.why: Ramsey advises listing debts by size and tackling the smallest.

questions.q: What is the target size of an emergency fund after debt reduction?
questions.why: He recommends a fund covering at least three months of expenses.

questions.q: Why does Ramsey liken debt repayment to a snowball?
questions.why: A small snowball gains size and speed, mirroring debt payoff progress.
